content: This is the discussion thread for #Lean Releases > v4.32.2.

I was trying to update to v4.32.1 but the same issue may be relevant. If I set the mathlib version to v4.31.1 I get the error that there is no such version. On the other hand, if I stick to v4.30.0 then downloading mathlib cache gives an error.

Siddhartha Gadgil said:

I was trying to update to v4.32.1 but the same issue may be relevant. If I set the mathlib version to v4.31.1 I get the error that there is no such version. On the other hand, if I stick to v4.30.0 then downloading mathlib cache gives an error.

For the record, neither batteries or mathlib are actually on 4.32.2 yet
They are not on the master/main branch, but there are commits with a corresponding git tag, see v4.32.2 in Mathlib for example
Does that mean I simply wait for a day or so?
I think this is meant to work already, but I can't speak to the cache issues. Maybe @Marcelo Lynch would know if any of the recent cache changes are relevant here?

v4.31.1 is not a release, so the 'no such version' is expected.

Siddhartha Gadgil said:

On the other hand, if I stick to v4.30.0 then downloading mathlib cache gives an error.

This is unexpected, what is the error? Could you give me some repro steps? I can't reproduce locally in a simple project that depends on mathlib at v4.30.0.
I've also tried v4.30.0 and v4.32.1 in a downstream repo and not been able to reproduce. Maybe try an rm -rf .lake for good measure?

Marcelo Lynch said:

v4.31.1 is not a release, so the 'no such version' is expected.

Siddhartha Gadgil said:

On the other hand, if I stick to v4.30.0 then downloading mathlib cache gives an error.

This is unexpected, what is the error? Could you give me some repro steps? I can't reproduce locally in a simple project that depends on mathlib at v4.30.0.

I guess what I said was ambiguous (and a bit worng). I meant that if the toolchain was v4.32.1 and the mathlib tag was 4.32.0 I got the error that the chache won't work. My main issue (as I reported elsewhere) was that from my institute network (and VPN) it takes incredibly long to download anything from a Github release, so I try to use versions I already have.

I meant that if the toolchain was v4.32.1 and the mathlib tag was 4.32.0 I got the error that the cache won't work

Oh, yes, this is always the case: the cached *.oleans for toolchain X are never compatible when building with toolchain Y
